/**
 * @file      ImplicitNetworkSolver.cpp
 * @brief     Standalone implicit finite-volume network solver for supported wet regimes.
 *
 * @author    Caleb Buahin <caleb.buahin@gmail.com>
 * @copyright Copyright (c) 2026 Caleb Buahin. All rights reserved.
 * @license   Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * @brief Select bounded wet SLOT mode from the problem enum.
 *
 * @param[in] p Problem whose regime is inspected.
 * @return True only for BoundedWetSlot; unsupported enum values are rejected separately.
 */

/**
 * @brief Compute the supported depth floor for a cell/face geometry.
 *
 * Does not validate or clamp the options; used as an admissibility rejection bound.
 *
 * @param[in] p Problem supplying regime and configured depth margins.
 * @param[in] g Geometry whose y_full defines the pressurized floor.
 * @return minimum_wet_depth in wet mode, otherwise y_full+minimum_slot_excess, in ft.
 */

/**
 * @brief Check that a wet closure evaluation has finite positive hydraulic quantities.
 *
 * @param[in] g Initialized geometry with coherent native closure.
 * @param[in] h Finite positive evaluation depth in ft; safe closure index conversion is a caller
 *     precondition.
 * @return True for finite area>kDryArea, width>0, moment, radius>0 and celerity.
 */

/**
 * @brief Read an optional aligned lateral-rate vector.
 *
 * @param[in] v Empty vector for all-zero forcing or a full indexed array.
 * @param[in] i Valid nonnegative index when v is nonempty, unchecked.
 * @return Zero for empty storage; otherwise v[i] in the vector shared units.
 */

/**
 * @brief Check every scalar in a vector for finite arithmetic.
 *
 * @param[in] v Read-only vector; may be empty.
 * @return True when every entry is finite, including the empty vector.
 */

/**
 * @brief Identify an algebraic or physical-storage node with an unknown head.
 *
 * @param[in] p Problem with aligned live mesh node_kind and fixed_head arrays.
 * @param[in] n Valid nonnegative node index, unchecked.
 * @return True only for junction/storage kinds with NaN fixed_head; finite prescribed heads and
 *     other kinds are excluded.
 */

/**
 * @brief Evaluate a physical-storage piecewise-linear native volume curve and active slope.
 *
 * Uses the left derivative at a rim coincident with a sample. Conversion to an integer panel occurs
 * before clamping, so unsupported nonfinite/out-of-int-range depths are unsafe. No
 * pond/extrapolated storage law is supplied.
 *
 * @param[in] m Validated mesh storage table with positive dmax, valid offset and 129 aligned
 *     monotone samples.
 * @param[in] j Valid storage node index.
 * @param[in] head Finite supported absolute head in ft, at/between invert and min(full_depth,dmax)
 *     above it.
 * @param[out] area Optional writable active dV/dh in ft2, or nullptr.
 * @return Interpolated volume in ft3; at/above table top returns the final sample.
 */

/**
 * @brief Check physical storage head against both absolute and depth bounds.
 *
 * The absolute comparison also rejects just-above-rim heads whose subtraction rounds back onto the
 * depth limit.
 *
 * @param[in] m Validated mesh storage invert/full-depth/table-top arrays.
 * @param[in] j Valid storage node index.
 * @param[in] head Proposed absolute head in ft.
 * @return True for finite depth in [0,min(full_depth,dmax)] and absolute head within the matching
 *     invert/rim interval.
 */

/**
 * @brief Validate the standalone network supported topology, regime and accepted history.
 *
 * Checks dimension/index/sign/CSR consistency, contiguous conduits, positive closure support, no
 * structures/local losses/gates/culverts/ponding/force mains, legal fixed/lateral boundaries and
 * exact optional accepted-depth/area consistency. Storage requires positive active table slopes, an
 * accepted old volume exactly matching its initial head, and bounded unknown rather than prescribed
 * stage. Can allocate degree/seen scratch and throw. Does not alter the problem.
 *
 * @param[in] p Problem with borrowed mesh and candidate old-state/forcing arrays.
 * @param[in] dt Required finite positive timestep in seconds.
 * @return True for coherent supported closed SLOT wet/pressure network data; false for unsupported
 *     or inconsistent input.
 */

/**
 * @brief Check a trial against supported finite wet-depth and node-head constraints.
 *
 * Ordinary unknown junction heads are further constrained by face reconstruction during residual
 * evaluation; this preliminary check does not alone certify every reconstructed side.
 *
 * @param[in] p Validated problem supplying geometry, bounds and fixed stages.
 * @param[in] x Trial arrays to inspect.
 * @return True for matching finite arrays, cell depths within bounds/valid wet closure, exact
 *     prescribed heads and bounded storage heads.
 */

/**
 * @brief Evaluate one shared HLL receipt with hydrostatic side corrections.
 *
 * Transforms cell discharge to the face axis, reconstructs both sides at max bed in the common face
 * geometry, extrapolates cell velocity to node ghosts or reflects closed ends, then uses shared HLL
 * kernels. No clipping, positivity scaling or separate bed source is added.
 *
 * @param[in] p Validated immutable problem and live mesh geometry.
 * @param[in] x Admissible aligned cell depth/Q and node-head trial.
 * @param[in] f Valid global face index.
 * @param[out] out Native volume/momentum flux and left/right momentum corrections; untouched on
 *     early reconstructed-depth rejection, potentially written before final finite failure.
 * @return True only for supported wet reconstructed sides and finite shared flux/corrections.
 */

/**
 * @brief Evaluate the signed Manning momentum sink at one trial cell.
 *
 * No zero-area/radius or finite guard is applied locally; the residual checks the resulting
 * arithmetic.
 *
 * @param[in] p Validated problem with native conduit rough_factor and geometry.
 * @param[in] x Admissible strictly wet trial with positive area/radius.
 * @param[in] c Valid cell index.
 * @return rough_factor*abs(Q/A)*Q/R^(4/3), in aggregate ft3/s2.
 */

/**
 * @brief Differentiate one wet face receipt in its local cell/head column basis.
 *
 * Local ordering is (h,Q) for each present left/right cell then optional head, at most five
 * columns. Uses active wet HLL branches and variable wave speeds; no global seeds, clipping or
 * finite-difference perturbations. Outputs can contain nonfinite values on failure.
 *
 * @param[in] p Validated BoundedWetSlot problem with positive wet geometry.
 * @param[in] x Admissible wet trial, including reconstructed side support.
 * @param[in] f Valid global face index.
 * @param[in] head_unknown Seed the attached node head as the final local independent variable when
 *     true.
 * @param[out] flux Differentiated mass/momentum receipt, written before the final finite check.
 * @param[out] left Differentiated left hydrostatic momentum correction.
 * @param[out] right Differentiated right hydrostatic momentum correction.
 * @return True if all primal values and five-direction derivatives are finite.
 */

/**
 * @brief Map unknown node heads to appended scalar Jacobian rows.
 *
 * @param[in] p Validated problem with aligned fixed-head/node-kind arrays and int-representable
 *     total unknown count.
 * @return Owned node-indexed row map: interleaved cell rows occupy [0,2*n), eligible nodes follow
 *     in node order, all others map to -1.
 */

/**
 * @brief Pack physical residuals into the current interleaved cell/head row order.
 *
 * Does not divide by row_scale; all dimensions/indices are caller-validated. Allocation can throw.
 *
 * @param[in] p Problem providing physical storage node kinds.
 * @param[in] e Aligned physical Evaluation with cell volume/momentum and node junction/storage
 *     defects.
 * @param[in] l Layout supplying row count and appended node ordering.
 * @return Owned unscaled residual: interleaved cell defects followed by storage-volume or
 *     algebraic-junction rows.
 */

/**
 * @file      ImplicitNetworkSolver.hpp
 * @brief     Standalone implicit finite-volume network solver for supported wet regimes.
 *
 * @author    Caleb Buahin <caleb.buahin@gmail.com>
 * @copyright Copyright (c) 2026 Caleb Buahin. All rights reserved.
 * @license   Apache-2.0
 */
/// Standalone, first-order SLOT experiment, pressurized-only by default with
/// opt-in bounded wet free-surface/transition support. Uses every
/// original cell and shared face geometry, including oriented virtual faces.
/// Junctions have ZERO storage; bounded physical storage uses mesh V(h) tables.
/// Ponding/overflow, structures, losses,
/// dry states, TPA and transport are deliberately unsupported.
/// Ordinary degree-2 nodes retain algebraic heads in both standalone scopes.
/// Typed virtual faces stay direct.
/// No production routing option or GUI selects this solver.

/**
         * @brief Multiply this CSR matrix by a nonoverlapping dense vector.
         *
         * Assumes valid row offsets, column bounds and aligned value storage; these are not checked here.
         * No allocation or ownership transfer occurs.
         *
         * @param[in] x Readable vector covering every column index; must not overlap y.
         * @param[out] y Writable row.size()-1 entries; rows before a nonfinite sum are already written on
         *     failure.
         * @return False on the first nonfinite row sum; true otherwise, including an empty row table.
         */
/// One active symbolic layout per workspace; not shared by concurrent calls.
/// Cached values are scratch only and are refilled/refactored on EVERY call.

/**
         * @brief Count retained symbolic/factor and native Krylov capacities.
         * @return Owned dynamic buffer bytes, excluding object/allocator/stack overhead.
         */

/**
         * @brief Free all owned workspace capacities and invalidate symbolic reuse.
         *
         * Swaps vectors with empty storage and clears NativeGmres workspace. No caller matrix/input/output
         * is retained or freed; serialize with all cache users.
         */

/**
         * @brief Check whether a cached symbolic layout exactly matches a new linear system.
         *
         * @param[in] a Source CSR pattern to compare; numeric values are intentionally ignored.
         * @param[in] backend Required scalar/block ILU backend.
         * @param[in] pairs Required leading two-variable block count.
         * @return True only for a valid cache with matching backend/pair count/row offsets/column indices.
         */

/**
         * @brief Count retained source-pattern, factor-index and numeric-factor capacities.
         * @return Owned factor/symbolic buffer bytes, excluding NativeGmres and object/allocator overhead.
         */

/**
         * @brief Interpret the combined condensation and fallback convergence status.
         * @return For no condensation uses GMRES status; otherwise true for successful condensation or
         *     successful permitted original-matrix fallback.
         */

/**
         * @brief Report nonlinear physical residual convergence.
         * @return True only when status is Status::Converged.
         */

/**
     * @brief Evaluate the original integrated cell equations and shared face/node receipts.
     *
     * Cell defects are volume ft3 and integrated momentum ft4/s. Junction rows are instantaneous net
     * inflow ft3/s; physical storage rows are Vnew-Vold-dt*inflow in ft3. One HLL mass receipt per face
     * feeds both adjacent cell/node ledgers; hydrostatic side corrections supply bed/section forces.
     * Rejects open/force-main geometry, structures, losses, gates, culverts, ponding, dry reconstructed
     * states and invalid history/storage bounds. Does not advance a clock, accepted state, carry or
     * mass ledger. Scratch allocation exceptions propagate.
     *
     * @param[in] p Supported immutable closed SLOT network and accepted old state. All arrays/topology
     *     must be coherent; cell A/Q are aggregate native ft2/ft3/s, heads/depths ft, storage volumes
     *     ft3 and lateral rates ft3/s into the system. Optional arrays are empty or fully aligned. No
     *     borrowed pointer is retained.
     * @param[in] x Finite trial cell depths/discharges and node heads, aligned to the problem. Fixed
     *     heads must equal prescribed values; cell/reconstructed depths and physical storage heads must
     *     remain within supported bounds.
     * @param[in] dt Finite positive timestep in seconds.
     * @param[out] output Receives full Evaluation only after all validation and finite checks succeed.
     * @return True for supported admissible finite evaluation; false preserves output.
     */

/**
     * @brief Build a scaled sparse Jacobian from local face/source derivatives.
     *
     * Interleaves cell (h,Q), then unknown junction/storage heads. PressurizedOnly re-evaluates local
     * face/friction finite differences, one-sided at bounds; BoundedWetSlot differentiates the actual
     * active wet closure/HLL branches analytically, including wave speeds. Storage/history derivatives
     * are analytic. Rows are sorted and duplicate contributions merged; no global dense Jacobian or
     * full-network perturbation per column. Allocation exceptions propagate.
     *
     * @param[in] p Supported immutable closed SLOT network and accepted old state. All arrays/topology
     *     must be coherent; cell A/Q are aggregate native ft2/ft3/s, heads/depths ft, storage volumes
     *     ft3 and lateral rates ft3/s into the system. Optional arrays are empty or fully aligned. No
     *     borrowed pointer is retained.
     * @param[in] x Finite trial cell depths/discharges and node heads, aligned to the problem. Fixed
     *     heads must equal prescribed values; cell/reconstructed depths and physical storage heads must
     *     remain within supported bounds.
     * @param[in] dt Finite positive timestep in seconds.
     * @param[in] step Finite positive relative finite-difference increment for PressurizedOnly; still
     *     validated in wet mode.
     * @param[out] output Receives complete CSR matrix, scaled residual, row/column scales and appended
     *     head-row ordering only on success.
     * @return False for unsupported/admissibility/finite/scaling/perturbation failure; true publishes
     *     the complete linearization.
     */

/**
     * @brief Solve a sparse system with fixed scalar ILU(0) right-preconditioned GMRES.
     *
     * Reuses only matching symbolic layout; numeric values are refilled/refactored every call. Small
     * ILU diagonal pivots receive a signed 0.01*max(1,row-scale) shift in the preconditioner only; the
     * actual A and b are unchanged. bad_alloc inside setup/solve maps to MemoryLimit; other exceptions
     * can propagate. No physical equation/endpoint is repaired here.
     *
     * @param[in] a Finite square nonempty CSR matrix matching rhs, with row[0]=0, nondecreasing row
     *     offsets, strictly increasing valid column indices per row and aligned values. Scalar ILU
     *     additionally requires a present diagonal in each row.
     * @param[in] rhs Finite scaled right-hand side; caller data is read-only and excluded from
     *     owned-workspace accounting.
     * @param[in] controls Native GMRES stopping/restart/workspace controls; owned factor/index
     *     capacities are deducted from its workspace budget.
     * @param[out] output Receives correction only after true-residual convergence; returned failure
     *     preserves existing contents.
     * @param[in,out] workspace Optional exclusive mutable symbolic/numeric/Krylov cache, or nullptr for
     *     call-local storage. Successful calls may retain capacities; failure releases the supplied
     *     cache. Never share one cache across concurrent solves.
     * @return Convergence, shifted-pivot, cache-reuse and memory/workspace diagnostics.
     */

/**
     * @brief Solve a mixed cell-pair/head system with fixed block ILU(0) right-preconditioned GMRES.
     *
     * Completes existing 1/2-variable preconditioner blocks and adds missing diagonal blocks; no
     * off-block fill or actual matrix/RHS changes. Unsafe diagonal inverses receive guarded factor
     * shifts. Reused symbols require exact source CSR pattern, backend and pair count; numeric factors
     * always refresh. bad_alloc maps to MemoryLimit, other exceptions may propagate.
     *
     * @param[in] a Finite square nonempty CSR matrix matching rhs, with row[0]=0, nondecreasing row
     *     offsets, strictly increasing valid column indices per row and aligned values. Scalar ILU
     *     additionally requires a present diagonal in each row.
     * @param[in] rhs Finite scaled right-hand side; caller data is read-only and excluded from
     *     owned-workspace accounting.
     * @param[in] cell_blocks Number of leading two-scalar cell blocks; <=rhs.size()/2. Remaining
     *     scalars are one-variable head blocks.
     * @param[in] controls Native GMRES controls and total owned block-factor/index/Krylov workspace
     *     cap.
     * @param[out] output Receives correction only after true-residual convergence; returned failure
     *     preserves existing contents.
     * @param[in,out] workspace Optional exclusive mutable symbolic/numeric/Krylov cache, or nullptr for
     *     call-local storage. Successful calls may retain capacities; failure releases the supplied
     *     cache. Never share one cache across concurrent solves.
     * @return GMRES, block pivot/shift and symbolic cache diagnostics.
     */

/**
     * @brief Eliminate eligible conduit interiors and verify a reconstructed full-system correction.
     *
     * Protects endpoint cell pairs and all heads. Exact interior two-by-two pivots are never shifted;
     * unsupported stencils, unsafe pivots, fill/memory/interface/reconstruction failures reject
     * condensation. Optional safe leaf elimination leaves unsafe leaves in the core. Dense interface
     * solving is capped; otherwise uses native GMRES. Both unpeeled Schur and original A*x-b must
     * satisfy budgets before publication. Workspace caps cover owned dynamic numeric/index capacities,
     * excluding caller matrix/RHS/output, vector objects and stack overhead. bad_alloc in the attempt
     * maps to MemoryLimit; other exceptions can propagate.
     *
     * @param[in] mesh Immutable conduit-cell partition: contiguous nonempty chains cover every cell;
     *     leading two scalars per cell match a/rhs ordering.
     * @param[in] a Finite square nonempty CSR matrix matching rhs, with row[0]=0, nondecreasing row
     *     offsets, strictly increasing valid column indices per row and aligned values. Scalar ILU
     *     additionally requires a present diagonal in each row.
     * @param[in] rhs Finite scaled right-hand side; caller data is read-only and excluded from
     *     owned-workspace accounting.
     * @param[in] linear Original-matrix GMRES stopping controls and full fallback workspace cap.
     * @param[in] controls Schur entry/workspace limits, dense threshold, optional tree-interface
     *     peeling and scalar/block preconditioner selection.
     * @param[in] allow_fallback Permit original-matrix GMRES after a non-invalid condensation failure
     *     and after temporary/cache cleanup.
     * @param[out] output Receives correction only after true-residual convergence; returned failure
     *     preserves existing contents.
     * @param[in,out] workspace Optional exclusive mutable symbolic/numeric/Krylov cache, or nullptr for
     *     call-local storage. Successful calls may retain capacities; failure releases the supplied
     *     cache. Never share one cache across concurrent solves.
     * @return Condensation diagnostics plus optional fallback GMRES status; use converged() to
     *     interpret the combined result.
     */

/**
     * @brief Balance ordinary unknown junction heads while holding conserved cell history fixed.
     *
     * Uses neighboring reconstructed-depth bounds, inward nextafter endpoints, endpoint/sign-bracket
     * checks and at most 128 scalar bisection evaluations. Does not invent a startup timestep or change
     * storage volume. Problem support is validated using a dummy 1-second interval; allocation
     * exceptions propagate.
     *
     * @param[in] p Supported immutable closed SLOT network and accepted old state. All arrays/topology
     *     must be coherent; cell A/Q are aggregate native ft2/ft3/s, heads/depths ft, storage volumes
     *     ft3 and lateral rates ft3/s into the system. Optional arrays are empty or fully aligned. No
     *     borrowed pointer is retained.
     * @param[in,out] x Admissible trial state copied locally; only ordinary unknown junction heads
     *     change on success. Storage accepted heads and cell A/Q are not reinitialized.
     * @param[in] tolerance Finite positive absolute net-junction-flow tolerance in ft3/s.
     * @return True after each ordinary junction meets tolerance; false leaves x unchanged.
     */

/**
     * @brief Solve one standalone network timestep with physical residual acceptance.
     *
     * Initializes algebraic heads with accepted cell history fixed, then performs bounded Newton and
     * admissible halved line searches. Optional seed changes the iterate but not conserved old state or
     * acceptance budgets. merit_window>0 permits bounded nonmonotone trial acceptance; final acceptance
     * still requires every original physical row budget. No water/momentum repair follows convergence.
     * Reusable instance workspace is exclusive, opt-in, numerically refactored each correction and
     * released on failed solves. Optional observer is synchronous: backtrack=-1 reports a Newton
     * iterate; null Evaluation marks an inadmissible trial. Callback arguments are borrowed only for
     * the invocation and must not be retained or used to reenter/mutate the solver/problem.
     * Allocation/callback exceptions propagate; returned failure preserves endpoint.
     *
     * @param[in] p Supported immutable closed SLOT network and accepted old state. All arrays/topology
     *     must be coherent; cell A/Q are aggregate native ft2/ft3/s, heads/depths ft, storage volumes
     *     ft3 and lateral rates ft3/s into the system. Optional arrays are empty or fully aligned. No
     *     borrowed pointer is retained.
     * @param[in] dt Finite positive timestep in seconds.
     * @param[in] controls Newton/backtracking limits, strictly positive finite absolute physical
     *     budgets, nonnegative relative budgets, linear selection/resources and optional seed/observer.
     *     merit_window is 0..32.
     * @param[out] output Complete endpoint areas/discharges/depths/heads, physical storage volumes and
     *     shared face receipts; published only on convergence.
     * @return Status and every attempted linear correction/residual/work diagnostic.
     */

/**
     * @brief Query retained instance linear-cache capacity.
     * @return Owned symbolic/numeric/Krylov buffer bytes; excludes allocator, object and stack
     *     overhead.
     */

/**
     * @brief Release instance symbolic, factor and Krylov buffers.
     *
     * Invalidates cached layout and frees retained vector capacities. Does not modify a previously
     * returned endpoint or external mesh/state. Serialize with solve and other workspace access.
     */

/**
 * @file      test_2d_exchange_rubinato_model.cpp
 * @brief     Rubinato et al. (2017) Table 2 in the full engine: the flume rebuilt
 *        from rig_geometry.yaml, each steady row's boundary conditions
 *        reconstructed, run to steady state, exchange compared with Q_e
 *        (1D2D fine-scale coupling plan §8.2, report-only per §0R R2).
 *
 * @details The paper does not tabulate the inflows; they are recovered from
 *          Table 2 itself. Surface inflow Q1 = Fr_s·√(g h_s)·h_s·W (the
 *          Froude number and depth at the surface transducer, uniform across
 *          the 4 m width; S4 has none). Sewer inflow Q3 = |Q_e / (surcharge_pct/100)| for S2–S4
 *          (Table 2 defines surcharge_pct = 100 (Q3-Q4)/Q3). The pipe
 *          Reynolds number must not be mistaken for the inlet flow. S1 has
 *          no sewer inflow. The manhole head is held at the measured h_p by a FIXED
 *          outfall stage 1 m downstream (S1: free outfall). The manhole sits
 *          at the flume centre (x 4 m, y 2 m) — an assumption. The mesh is
 *          a uniform 0.2 m grid, NOT the paper's 0.0125 m refinement: a
 *          junction exchanges through ONE cell, so cells far smaller than the
 *          0.045 m² opening concentrate the whole exchange in a sliver the
 *          explicit solver (and the equalisation cap) must throttle —
 *          spreading a structure over its footprint cells is plan §10 work.
 *          The pond is
 *          the 0.24 m shaft (COUPLING_POND_MODE CHAMBER): under the legacy
 *          FOOTPRINT pond a fine mesh leaves the node a ~1e-4 m² pond, and
 *          a spill can release only what that pond holds.
 *
 *          Absolute agreement is REPORTED, not gated: Table 3's coefficients
 *          are regression slopes with intercepts (§0R R2), and these boundary
 *          conditions are reconstructions. The test asserts that every run
 *          completes and the exchange has the measured direction and order
 *          of magnitude (|Q_num| > Q_e/4 — a choke detector); routing
 *          continuity is reported (the 3-node network's DW node bookkeeping,
 *          not the coupling, dominates it). Results land in
 *          ./rubinato2017_model_out/model_vs_table2.csv (one row per case).
 *          All 36 rows run (~15 s); S1 rows run under the legacy ORIFICE
 *          law as well.
 *
 * @ingroup engine_2d
 *
 * @author    Caleb Buahin <caleb.buahin@gmail.com>
 * @copyright Copyright (c) 2026 Caleb Buahin. All rights reserved.
 * @license   Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * @brief Read simple colon-delimited numeric benchmark rig fields.
 *
 * Skips empty lines and column-zero # comments, uses text before first colon verbatim as key and
 * atof afterward. Does not trim, validate conversion, support YAML nesting/quotes or report
 * malformed numeric values (often converted to zero).
 *
 * @param[in] p Input path for the controlled flat key:value fixture.
 * @return Owned map; duplicate exact keys overwrite and absent/unreadable files produce an empty
 *     map.
 */

/**
 * @brief Read the controlled unquoted benchmark table using its first line as keys.
 *
 * No quoted-field/embedded-comma handling, trimming, CR removal or schema/numeric validation.
 * Unreadable input returns no rows; allocation errors propagate.
 *
 * @param[in] p Readable comma-delimited fixture path, unchanged.
 * @return Owned nonempty data-line maps; missing cells remain absent, extra cells are ignored and
 *     duplicate keys overwrite.
 */

/**
 * @brief Build graded grid coordinates outward from a central point to two endpoints.
 *
 * Builds each side independently, reversing the lower side before concatenation. Does not validate
 * geometry/progress or cap count; unsuitable zero/negative/vanishing spacings can stall or
 * overallocate.
 *
 * @param[in] lo Finite lower endpoint in metres, strictly less than c.
 * @param[in] hi Finite upper endpoint in metres, strictly greater than c.
 * @param[in] c Interior center coordinate in metres.
 * @param[in] h0 Positive finite initial spacing in metres.
 * @param[in] hmax Positive finite spacing cap, intended at least h0.
 * @param[in] g Finite spacing growth factor at least one for the intended terminating graded grid.
 * @return Owned increasing coordinate vector from lo through c to hi; endpoint gaps follow the
 *     half-current-spacing stopping rule.
 */

/**
 * @brief Construct the graded flume/manhole benchmark deck with measured case forcing.
 *
 * Uses axis growth1.1, fixed held pipe/outfall forcing and Rubinato2017 manhole coefficients.
 * Requires positive dimensions and derived vertex/cell counts fitting int; no
 * syntax/finite/physical validation or simulation occurs. Rig/Case references are not retained.
 *
 * @param[in] c Scenario inputs: q1/q3 m3/s and downstream head h_p metres; selects sewer feed when
 *     q3>0.
 * @param[in] rig Required named rig dimensions/slopes/roughness/diameters/crest/spacing map;
 *     missing keys throw out_of_range.
 * @param[in] law Raw COUPLING_LAW token inserted verbatim.
 * @param[in] h0 Positive center mesh spacing in metres, not initial water depth.
 * @param[in] extra2d Raw additional 2D_OPTIONS text with required newline delimiters.
 * @param[in] physical_shaft Use a real circular-area manhole storage and matching minimum area when
 *     true; otherwise ordinary junction.
 * @return Owned five-minute CMS/DYNWAVE deck with graded triangular flume, center vertex MH map,
 *     downstream normal flow and optional upstream flow boundary.
 */
///< steady exchange, + = sewer → surface

/**
 * @brief Run a flume/manhole case and measure last-minute exchange and nearby depth/head.
 *
 * Writes/opens/initializes/starts with output disabled, chooses nearest centroid to the upstream
 * sensor target, and measures cumulative exchange windows after 180/240 s. Requires successful
 * step/end, late coverage>=299 s, ordered windows and positive sample time before setting
 * finite-result ok. Many getter/report/close statuses remain unchecked; probe is approximate and no
 * time interpolation/exact experimental-location reconstruction occurs. Destroys engine on returned
 * paths; filesystem/map/allocation exceptions propagate.
 *
 * @param[in] c Measured case forcing forwarded to deck.
 * @param[in] rig Required rig map including flume dimensions and p_surface_offset_m for
 *     nearest-cell probe selection.
 * @param[in] law Raw coupling law forwarded to deck.
 * @param[in] tag Safe artifact basename beneath kOut for .inp/.rpt, overwritten.
 * @param[in] h0 Positive center mesh spacing override in metres; nonpositive selects rig
 *     mesh_size_boundary_m.

/**
 * @file      test_2d_exchange_rubinato_steady.cpp
 * @brief     The WEIR_ORIFICE law against Rubinato et al. (2017) Table 2/3.
 *
 * @details For each of the 36 steady rows the law is evaluated in the row's
 *          regime with unit coefficients on the rig (D_M = 0.24 m, crest
 *          0.478 m above the pipe invert, φ head scaled to the 1/6 rig), which
 *          gives the paper's equation term X (Eqs. 1, 2, 4). Regressing the
 *          measured Q_e on X recovers Table 3's coefficient as the slope — the
 *          paper's own fit, which has an intercept (−2.5 and −3.8 l/s for the
 *          orifice scenarios), so the gate is the slope (±0.01) and R² ≥ 0.96,
 *          not the absolute flow (plan §0R R2). The absolute law-vs-measured
 *          comparison is written to ./rubinato_steady_out/ for review only.

 * @brief Read the simple unquoted steady-exchange reference CSV.
 *
 * Splits literal commas, preserves trailing empty fields, skips only empty lines, fills missing
 * cells with empty text and discards extra cells. Duplicate headers overwrite and CR may remain; no
 * quoting, whitespace normalization or numeric conversion.
 *
 * @param[in] p Reference filename borrowed for synchronous text read.
 * @return Owned header-keyed row maps; empty on missing first line/open failure.

/**
 * @brief Evaluate the unit-coefficient exchange term selected by a reference scenario.
 *
 * Uses fixed manhole geometry and 1/6-scale head regularization; S1/S2 disable limiting orifice
 * with 1e9 coefficient and set relevant weir coefficients, other scenarios set outflow orifice
 * coefficient one. map::at/stod errors propagate; unknown scenarios follow the latter branch

 * @param[in] row Required scenario/h_s_m and, except S1, h_p_m keys with valid numeric text; heads
 *     use meters.
